Definition: properly, to eliminate, i.e. (intransitively) to dry up
BiblicalUsage: The waters of Egypt fail and the river wastes away and dries up, and the might of Babylon's warriors fails them when the enemy comes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that drying up is how God empties the proud: the river that fed Egypt runs dry, the warriors who trusted their strength find it gone, and nothing remains but the word of the LORD.
